Tropical Shaved Ice

Served at: Tiki Christmas at Pearl Harbor

Serves 4Prep 15 min

Shaved Ice is a refreshing and colorful treat enjoyed during Tiki Christmas celebrations at Pearl Harbor, where the tropical ambiance and festive spirit come together. This icy dessert is perfect for cooling down while enjoying the holiday festivities in the warm Hawaiian climate.

Ingredients

  • 4 cups ice cubes
  • 1 cup pineapple juice (240 ml)
  • 1/2 cup coconut milk (120 ml)
  • 1/4 cup passion fruit syrup (60 ml)
  • 1/4 cup guava syrup (60 ml)
  • Fresh fruit for garnish (pineapple chunks, maraschino cherries, kiwi slices)

Method

  1. Place the ice cubes in a blender or use a shaved ice machine to finely shave the ice until fluffy and snow-like.
  2. Divide the shaved ice evenly into 4 serving bowls or cups.
  3. Drizzle pineapple juice over the shaved ice in each bowl to soak the ice slightly.
  4. Next, pour a tablespoon of coconut milk over each serving for a creamy tropical flavor.
  5. Spoon passion fruit syrup and guava syrup alternately over the ice to create colorful layers and enhance sweetness.
  6. Garnish each serving with fresh fruit such as pineapple chunks, maraschino cherries, and kiwi slices.
  7. Serve immediately with spoons and enjoy the cool, tropical flavors.

Tips

  • Use fresh fruit syrups or make your own by simmering fruit juice with sugar until thickened.
  • For an adult twist, add a splash of rum to the syrups before drizzling.
  • If you don't have a shaved ice machine, crush ice in a sturdy plastic bag using a rolling pin or use a blender on pulse mode for best texture.
